business_problem: At Virgin Atlantic, we’ve always seen ourselves as a challenger—willing to take bold bets that help us stand apart. AI fits that philosophy perfectly.
solution_summary: At Virgin Atlantic, we’ve always seen ourselves as a challenger—willing to take bold bets that help us stand apart. AI fits that philosophy perfectly. Being a smaller airline compared to our global competitors means we need to find smart ways to offset scale disadvantages. Leading-edge technology gives us that edge. The clearest wins came from our digital and software development teams. Using AI, we’re writing and testing code faster, shipping features more quickly, and improving customer experience at speed. In aviation, that’s a huge differentiator—whether it’s our mobile app, check-in experience, or loyalty program. Cycle times are shorter, and customers feel that progress.
